overview: You tied the parcel again and wrote three questions. Who stands by when a crown changes hands. What the old man is called before he is given words. Whether a comedy ends at the marriages or at the broken oaths. You wrote no line for anyone to speak.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Tied the parcel and left the questions as questions.

assets.name: Holinshed, second volume
assets.disposition: Wrote three questions and retied the parcel

summary: Wrote three questions and retied the parcel
